On 14 October 2021, Sunil Chhetri surpassed Pele's record of 77 international goals to become one of the world's top goal scorers. The Government of India Act, 1935 introduced provincial autonomy by replacing dyarchy with fully responsible provincial governments. The Act allowed Indian ministers to control all provincial departments, except for defense and foreign affairs, which remained under British control.

The PK Thungon Committee (1989) recommended giving constitutional status to Panchayati Raj institutions and suggested the three-tier system of local governance. This led to the 73rd and 74th Constitutional Amendments (1992), granting Panchayati Raj and Municipalities constitutional recognition.

The Singh Sabha Movement was started in 1873 in Amritsar. It was a Sikh reform movement aimed at returning to the true Sikh religion and countering the influences of Christian missionaries and Hindu reform movements. The movement worked to promote Sikh education, literature, and reform, and helped establish the Khalsa College in Amritsar in 1892.

Ranjana Prakash Desai is a former Supreme Court judge of India. She was appointed as the first woman chairperson of the Press Council of India (PCI) in 2022.The PCI is responsible for maintaining journalistic ethics and freedom of the press in India.

Pandit Bhimsen Joshi, a legendary Hindustani classical vocalist, was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 2008, making him the first vocalist to receive the honor. He was a master of Khyal Gayaki, a style of Hindustani music.

Venation refers to the pattern of veins in leaves:

• Reticulate venation (net-like structure) is found in dicots (e.g., China rose, Tulsi, Coriander).

• Parallel venation (parallel veins) is found in monocots (e.g., Maize, Grass, Banana).

Thus, Maize does not have reticulate venation.

The third edition of the Khelo India University Games (KIUG) 2023 was hosted by Uttar Pradesh across multiple cities, including Lucknow, Varanasi, and Gorakhpur. These games aim to promote sports among university students.

The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) comprises:

• Chairperson: A former Chief Justice of India

• Members: A former Supreme Court judge, a former High Court Chief Justice, and experts in human rights

• Ex-officio members from commissions like SC/ST, Women, and Minorities

A District Magistrate (DM) is not part of NHRC but may assist in implementing human rights-related measures at the local level.

The Bhagirathi and Alaknanda rivers meet at Devaprayag in Uttarakhand. After this confluence, the river is known as the Ganga (Ganges). Devaprayag is one of the Panch Prayag (five confluences) of Alaknanda River and is considered one of the holiest places in Hinduism. The town of Devaprayag is situated at an elevation of 830 meters above sea level.

Major Rock Edict XIII describes Ashoka's remorse after the Kalinga War, where he realized the consequences of violence and adopted Dhamma (moral governance). This led him to promote non-violence and Buddhism across his empire and in foreign lands.

The Pandya Kingdom, one of the three ancient Tamil kingdoms (along with Chera and Chola), had its capital at Madurai. Megasthenes, the Greek ambassador to the Mauryan court, mentioned the Pandya Kingdom in his work "Indica" and noted their famous pearl trade. Madurai remained their capital throughout their reign and was an important center of Tamil culture and learning.

Yamini Krishnamurthy is a renowned classical dancer primarily associated with Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi. She has received the Padma Bhushan and Padma Vibhushan for her contributions to Indian classical dance.

The Harivarasanam award is given by the Kerala state government. It is named after the famous Sanskrit hymn "Harivarasanam" sung at the Sabarimala temple. This prestigious award recognizes excellence in music and contributions to the field of devotional music. The award includes a cash prize, citation, and plaque.

The 'food, work, and productivity' slogan was used in the Seventh Five-Year Plan of India.

Five-Year Plans in India are detailed macroeconomic plans created by the Planning Commission (now NITI Aayog) to guide economic development. The Seventh Five-Year Plan, which ran from 1985 to 1990, emphasized economic growth, agricultural productivity, and employment generation.

The slogan "food, work, and productivity" reflected the plan's focus on addressing basic economic needs, creating employment opportunities, and improving overall economic efficiency.

The National Air Sports Policy (NASP) 2022 was introduced to promote air sports such as paragliding, paramotoring, skydiving, and ballooning. It aims to make India a global hub for air sports and ensure safety and regulatory measures through the Air Sports Federation of India (ASFI).
According to the Census 2011, Thane district in Maharashtra had the highest population among all districts in India, with a population of 11 million (1.1 crore).

Easter is one of the most important festivals in Christianity. It celebrates the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead, which occurred three days after his crucifixion. Easter marks the end of the Lenten period of fasting and is preceded by Good Friday. The festival typically falls between late March and late April.

=> 3√5/5

Option (a) is the correct answer.

Average of first n natural numbers = (n + 1)/2

n = 125

Average = (125 + 1)/2

=> 126/2 = 63

questions.question: Simplify the given expression 4x 2 + 9y 2 - 12xy _________ 3y - 2x दिए गए व्यंजक को सरल बनाएं 4x 2 + 9y 2 - 12xy _________ 3y - 2x
questions.questionHtml:
Simplify the given expression 
4x2 + 9y2 - 12xy_________3y - 2x

दिए गए व्यंजक को सरल बनाएं

4x2 + 9y2 - 12xy_________3y - 2x
questions.solution:
4x2 + 9y2 - 12xy can be written as (2x - 3y)2

(4x2 + 9y2 - 12xy)/(3y - 2x) = (2x - 3y)2/(3y - 2x)

And also we can write 3y - 2x as - (2x - 3y)

Now (4x2 + 9y2 - 12xy)/(3y - 2x) = (2x - 3y)2/-(2x - 3y)

=> -(2x - 3y) or 3y - 2x

A number is divisible by 36 if it is divisible by both 4 and 9.

A number is divisible by 4 if the last two digits must form a number divisible by 4.

A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of all digits must be divisible by 9.

Last two digits are 6y6, so for divisibility by 4:

y6 must be divisible by 4.

Possible values for y can be 1, 3, 5, 7, 9

Sum of digits :- 5 + x + 7 + 9 + 8 + 5 + 6 + y + 6 = 46 + x + y

For divisibility by 9, (46 + x + y) must be divisible by 9.

Taking y = 9 (largest possible value):

46 + x + 9 = 55 + x

55 + x must be divisible by 9.

Possible values for x = 8 (as 55 + 8 = 63)

so, x = 8 and y = 9

Now,

Negative value of √(2x + y) = √(2 X 8 + 9) = √25 = - 5

Let the centers of the two circles be p and q respectively and let the common chord be AB. The line joining the centers p and q is perpendicular to the chord AB and bisects it at point M.

Thus, in the right triangle pMA we know :

pA = 13 cm(radius of the circle), pM = d(the perpendicular distance from the center to the midpoint of the chord), AM = x(half the length of the common chord)

applying the pythagoras theorem in triangle pMA :

pA2 = PM2 + AM2

substituting the values we get,

132 = d2 + x2

169 = d2 + x2

We also know the distance between the centers of the circles is 13 cm, so the distance from the center to the midpoint of the chord is :

pq = 13 = 2d

therefore, d = 13/2

now substitute this value of d into the Pythagoras theorem :

169 = (13/2)2 + x2

169 = 169/4 + x2

x2 = 169 - 169/4

=> 507/4

x = √(507)/2

Finally, the total length of the common chord is twice the value of AM, or:

Length of the common chord = 2x = 2 * √(507)/2 = √507 or 13√3 (approx.)

Let Anna have A marbles and Ben have B marbles.

According to question,

A - 1 = B + 1.......(i)

A + 1 = 3(B - 1)........(ii)

From (i) :

A - 1 = B + 1

=> A = B + 2

From (ii) :

A + 1 = 3(B - 1)

Substitute A = B + 2 in the (ii):

(B + 2) + 1 = 3(B - 1)

=> B + 3 = 3B - 3

=> 6 = 2B

=> B = 3

Substitute B = 3 in A = B + 2:

A = 3 + 2

=> A = 5

Total number of marbles = A + B

Total number of marbles = 5 + 3

=> Total number of marbles = 8
